To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

16 special education/human exceptionalities introductory survey texts published between 1988 and 1992 included some multicultural content, and five of these texts contained considerably more multicultural content than the others.

16 special education introductory textbooks were analyzed for the presence and amount of multicultural information and content; a list of multicultural indicators, based on ERIC descriptors, was formulated; all 16 textbooks included some multicultural information or content; 5 textbooks contained a considerably larger amount of information and/or content; and the amount and location of the multicultural information and content varied among the textbooks.

16 special education textbooks contained multicultural information and content; 5 of the textbooks contained a considerably more substantial amount; and the amount of multicultural information and content varied considerably among textbooks and across chapters.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the inclusion of multicultural content in introductory survey texts in special education/human exceptionalities.
the inclusion of multicultural content in the special education introductory survey textbooks used in teacher education programs.
the extent to which special education textbooks are providing the information and content necessary for teachers to be effective in today's diverse classrooms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the 16 special education/human exceptionalities textbooks examined contained a considerable amount of multicultural information and content and were in compliance with the new CEC/NCATE standards and guidelines.
special education/human exceptionalities survey texts do include multicultural information and content, but there is room for improvement.
the 16 textbooks included a considerable amount of information and material related to multicultural issues, but the content is still limited in scope and depth.

multicultural content is being included in introductory special education/human exceptionalities survey texts, and that the amount and type of content is increasing.
the 16 textbooks examined contained some multicultural information and that five of the 16 contained a considerably greater quantity of information.
the 16 textbooks examined contained multicultural information and content that could be used by teacher education students to develop a multicultural perspective.

the special education textbooks we examined did not adequately cover multicultural issues, but there was a wide range of variation in the amount of multicultural content included.
